description: For handyman repair, this estimate worksheet records diagnostic boundary, repair approach, parts, protection, estimated labor, exclusions, and restoration expectations. Its supporting evidence includes existing-condition photos, measurements, model data, test results, material receipts, and completed-repair photos.
